description: Defines the abstract class rx::BufferImpl for buffer management in graphics rendering, including virtual methods for data operations and memory size retrieval.

classes.name: BufferImpl
classes.description: Abstract class for buffer operations in graphics rendering, with virtual methods for data setting, copying, mapping, and size retrieval.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Virtual method to destroy the buffer with a given context.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Virtual method to set buffer data.

methods.name: setSubData
methods.description: Virtual method to update a subset of buffer data.

methods.name: copySubData
methods.description: Virtual method to copy data from another buffer.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Virtual method to map the buffer for access.

methods.name: mapRange
methods.description: Virtual method to map a range of the buffer.

methods.name: unmap
methods.description: Virtual method to unmap the buffer.

methods.name: getIndexRange
methods.description: Virtual method to get index range information.

methods.name: getMemorySize
methods.description: Returns the memory size of the buffer; default implementation returns 0.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Method called when buffer data changes.
